title: Shore-Power and Galvanic Watch
dataSources: NMEA/SignalK data (`nmea:reading`), bilge pump (`bilge:event`), mooring/anchor watch (`mooring:status`), marine weather (`marineweather:forecast`).
app: Marine electronics — NMEA 2000 / SignalK boat networks, bilge, battery and shore-power sensors, anchor-watch GPS, and marine weather feeds — streamed to Splunk HEC via SignalK and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=nmea:reading measurement=shorepower
| stats latest(connected) as connected, latest(leakage_ma) as leakage by _time
| eval fault=if(leakage>30,1,0)
| where fault=1
description: Monitors shore-power connection and leakage current, flagging the faults behind galvanic corrosion and shock risk.
value: Stray current at the dock corrodes fittings and endangers swimmers; catching leakage protects boat and people.
implementation: Ingest shore-power telemetry into `index=personal`; alert on excessive leakage current.
visualization: Table of shore-power sessions with leakage faults.
grandmaExplanation: It watches the boat's dock power for electrical leaks that cause corrosion and shock danger.
